Specification: This module compares initialization evaluation order for two separate instances of another module, Base, instantiated as S1 and S2 with different clock variables Clk1 and Clk2. It defines four specifications that differ only in the order of the conjuncts used to initialize the two instances and assert equality between the clocks, while each specification then allows only stuttering steps via a temporal formula over the combined instance variables. The file is focused on checking whether reordering initialization conjuncts changes the meaning of the combined specification; it contains no explicit fault model, no proofs, and no fairness conditions.
